note: Each task is phrased the way a person or a model would ask for it, not copied from tool descriptions: the router is lexical, so borrowed wording would flatter it. `expect` lists tools (unqualified) that must be enabled for the task to count as served. `minProfile` is the smallest agent-orchestrator profile that offers them. `expect: []` marks a task no tool fits: the right outcome is that the gate enables nothing.

tasks.task: Run this instruction on a suitable agent and give me the result
Queue a long job and check on its state later
Wait until my jobs are finished
Cancel the job that is still running
Apply the same instruction to each of these 50 items in parallel
Show what is waiting for a human to approve, then approve one
Is the orchestrator healthy and which tool profile is active?
Read the artifact that the last job produced
Define a workflow with several steps and start it
Save a note to shared memory and search it again later
How many tokens did my agents use this week?
Create a persistent agent of my own
Preview when my schedule would fire next
Set a spending budget for my agents
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Explain how the Python garbage collector works
